{{Top|leg}}
'''Locker 4599''' was a seemingly normal large locker, located at the [[Estaria Central Starport]]. Part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Estaria Cache]], Locker 4599 had been modified to allow access between the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] concourse and the warehouse. [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] could step into Locker 4599, look through a peephole into the room beyond to make sure it was clear, then transit between the two areas.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
